limits: Alternate compositions of named entries only. No elements package or workspace source aliases.
Native semantic and computed-style scenarios only; manual AT, native clipboard transport, SSR/hydration and full theme visual acceptance remain separate.

runtime.policy: Locally resolved browser installations and executable bytes; no inference from package version alone.

earlierAttempts.boundary: 68 passed,1 failed,75 not run: Firefox computed scrollbar-width differs from the assumed auto baseline. Reproduced in isolated native CSS.
110 passed,1 failed,33 not run: WebKit sequential button navigation follows native Option+Tab policy.
119 passed,1 failed,24 not run: WebKit does not support forced-color-adjust; asserted the explicit capability branch rather than inventing support.

postQualificationDocumentation: Styles README adds the qualified contract link after the browser run; execution does not depend on that prose. Runtime CSS parity with the final production build is checked separately.
limitations: Five additional entries have bounded native composition qualification;78/110 entries qualified and32 remain pending.

Finite carousel collection, not virtualized large-collection or scroll-focus qualification. Pagination and carousel styles are scoped to application shadow roots; their matching recipe classes are not APIs into delivered components.

Pinned headless Firefox reports scrollbar-width:none even for a plain native scrollport explicitly set to auto; uncontrolled carousel comparison uses that baseline, not a retail visual-scrollbar claim.
WebKit uses Option+Tab for native sequential navigation and lacks forced-color-adjust support; tests assert the capability branch and retain selected/current-state assertions.

Manual AT, physical touch/IME, retail Safari, alternate OS/device conditions, full SSR/hydration and other platform/separate-owner acceptance remain open. Historical external CSS-authoring rerun is retired, never passed.
